options.name: apiKey
options.description: The project's API key. Falls back to `SLEN_API_KEY`.

options.name: baseUrl
options.description: Host root without `/api`, for tests and a local stack. Default: the hosted API.

options.name: timeoutMs
options.description: How long one attempt may take, in ms. Default 65 000.

options.name: retries
options.description: Attempts after the first when there is no answer, a 429 or a 503. Default 2.

options.name: logger
options.description: Where the journal goes: `console` or any logger with `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`. Default: nowhere.

options.name: otlp
options.description: Sends spans to an OTLP/HTTP collector, next to `spanRecorder`.

options.name: fetch
options.description: The `fetch` requests are sent with. Default: the runtime's own.

options.name: headers
options.description: Extra headers on every request. The SDK's own headers win over them.

options.name: webhookSecret
options.description: The signing secret of your webhook endpoint, for verifying `Slen-Signature`.

options.name: webhookToleranceSeconds
options.description: How old a webhook signature may be, in seconds. Default 300.
